question: Which community areas (by name) have a violent crime rate above 20% of their total crimes?
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT can.community_area_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_crimes,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ci."VIOLENT_CRIME_FLAG" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS violent_rate_pct
FROM crime_incidents ci JOIN community_area_names can ON ci."COMMUNITY_AREA" = can.community_area_id
GROUP BY can.community_area_name
HAVING ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ci."VIOLENT_CRIME_FLAG" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) > 20
ORDER BY violent_rate_pct DESC;
agent_sql_query:
WITH area_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ci."COMMUNITY_AREA" AS area_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_crimes,
        SUM(ci."VIOLENT_CRIME_FLAG") AS violent_crimes
    FROM crime_incidents ci
    GROUP BY ci."COMMUNITY_AREA"
)
SELECT
    cn.community_area_name AS community_area,
    a.total_crimes,
    a.violent_crimes,
    ROUND(100.0 * a.violent_crimes / NULLIF(a.total_crimes, 0), 2) AS violent_crime_rate_percent
FROM area_stats a
JOIN community_area_names cn
    ON a.area_id = cn.community_area_id
